settings.author: Emily R.
settings.body: Obsessed is an understatement! These look and feel 100% like a £70 salon gel set. Lasted 18 days with the glue and zero lifting.

settings.author: Chloe M.
settings.body: The quality of the gel polish is unbelievable! So sturdy, didn’t bend or chip once. The packaging is gorgeous with the little heart box too.

settings.author: Sophie T.
settings.body: First time using press-ons and I am completely converted. Application took less than 10 minutes and they look so natural!
